title: ProcessFeatures
description: Structured forensic and live behavioral telemetry schema for the Process modality (Track A). Scored by XGBoost.

total_process_count.description: Total count of active running processes at acquisition time

hidden_process_count.description: Processes found by unlinked scan (psscan/psxview) but absent from active process list (pslist)
hidden_process_count.source: Volatility3 windows.psscan, windows.psxview / cross-referenced live scan

anomalous_ppid_count.description: Processes whose parent PID does not match standard Windows process hierarchy (e.g. svchost not spawned by services.exe)
anomalous_ppid_count.source: Volatility3 windows.pstree / Sysmon Event ID 1 parent-child verification

avg_threads_per_process.description: Average thread count per active process

max_threads_in_single_process.description: Peak thread count observed within a single process

total_handle_count.description: Aggregate open object handles across all running processes

suspicious_dll_count.description: Count of loaded DLLs from abnormal directories (e.g. AppData, Temp, or unlinked modules)

malfind_process_count.description: Number of processes with memory regions flagged by malfind as containing injected/modified code

elevated_privilege_count.description: Processes possessing enabled high-risk privileges (e.g. SeDebugPrivilege, SeTcbPrivilege)

unlinked_dll_count.description: Loaded modules in memory not present in the InLoadOrderModuleList (reflective DLL loading indicator)
